title: Data engineer interview: project walkthrough
summary: Explain one project from problem to architecture, trade-offs, implementation and measurable outcome.

blocks.text: Explain one project from problem to architecture, trade-offs, implementation and measurable outcome.

items: Start with the business/data problem and constraints.
Draw the source → ingestion → storage → transformation → serving path.
Name one trade-off you made and one alternative you rejected.
Finish with reliability, performance or business impact and what you would improve next.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
